title: Reference 1 — sage blossom meadow

reference_usage.description: Use only the sage-green meadow with scattered small pink blossoms as scene composition; no blue sky, trees, or hill panorama. Identity cues: Chiikawa round white with tiny ears and blush; Hachiware white cat with blue-gray split cap; Usagi butter-yellow long-eared rabbit with tiny buck teeth.
reference_usage.imagegen_reference_order: The four attached images were provided together to ImageGen in conversation order; image #1 was called out as the sole scene reference, images #2–#4 for character identity.
